is_anopheles.evidence: Adult mosquitoes identified morphologically as Anopheles gambiae s.l., Anopheles funestus s.l., and Anopheles nili, with molecular identification of Anopheles coluzzii and Anopheles gambiae s.s. (page 2, 5, 7).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Tested for the L1014F kdr mutation (Vgsc L995F) using PCR following Martinez-Torres et al. (page 5, 9).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Page 9 states: 'Frequency of the L1014F kdr mutation in An. gambiae s.s. was 89.8% (95% CI: 88.2–91.2, n = 829) compared to 84.3% (95% CI: 82.5–85.9, n = 968) in An. coluzzii collected during HLC.' Per-district breakdown is provided in S2 Table.

african_field_population.evidence: Field-caught adult mosquitoes collected by human landing catches (HLC) between September and October 2019 in Cove, Zagnanando, and Ouinhi districts, southern Benin (page 3, 5).

is_primary_study.evidence: Primary field entomological survey providing baseline characteristics in 60 villages prior to a cluster randomized controlled trial (page 1, 3).

sub_country_location.evidence: Conducted in 60 villages across Cove, Zagnanando, and Ouinhi districts in southern Benin, with GPS coordinates provided for districts (page 3).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Mosquito collections were carried out between September and October 2019 (page 3).

duplicate_risk.evidence: Baseline entomological collections conducted specifically for an RCT under 'The New Nets Project'; no mention of overlapping previously published genotype datasets.

supplement.evidence: District-specific allele frequencies are located in 'S2 Table. Allelic frequencies of the L1014F kdr mutation in An. gambiae s.s and An. coluzzii collected using HLCs.' which is not included in the manuscript PDF.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated vector population bionomics, insecticide resistance, and L1014F kdr frequency in Anopheles gambiae s.s. (n = 829) and Anopheles coluzzii (n = 968) across three districts in southern Benin in 2019 prior to a dual-AI net randomized controlled trial.
